systems.platform: addressing system developed by the Eswatini Standards Authority; unique formal property addresses linked to Google Maps
systems.owner: Eswatini Communications Commission (ESCCOM), initiated 2020 with Ministry of ICT support; implemented by the municipality
systems.tiers: Matsapha, the first municipality to roll out, within its municipal boundaries only; street signs due within eight weeks of 11 September 2026

note: Street addressing and signs in Matsapha, reported 11 September 2026: a property-address scheme, logged as an application. The article says nothing of the council office's connection or of staff working in any online system.
